ctxGlossary:
Tokenized Money Market Fund — A digital representation of traditional money market funds on blockchain.
Curated Capital — Capital managed or allocated through vetted, onchain protocols or platforms.
Burn — Permanent removal of tokens from circulation, reducing supply.
